some of the models of customer choice used by operations management researchers perform best in empirical tests of model fit and that the number of consecutive choices of a particular supplier is increasing in the supplier's expected quality level, a result consistent both with the models' theoretical predictions and with loyalty effects described by management practitioners.
the most tractable choice rules perform the best in bandit experiments.
